capability: Fail fast on capability-record index/worktree byte drift before the expensive Git-history audit
searchEvidence: validate_capability_reuse_governance currently calls _historical_final_records before comparing indexed record bytes with worktree bytes.
test_record_must_match_its_exact_index_blob already owns the fail-closed index/worktree mismatch contract.
A sentinel probe confirmed that the history audit starts before the current-snapshot mismatch is reported.
terminalContract: The canonical validator performs one exact-byte current-snapshot preflight before any capability-record history audit. An indexed capability record that differs from its worktree file fails immediately with the existing fail-closed diagnostic; matching staged final records continue through every existing history, checkpoint, digest, and evidence gate. No second verifier, automatic staging, or weakened authority is introduced.

designReview.evidence: Independent read-only inspection confirmed that _historical_final_records precedes exact index/worktree comparison. The approved minimum change is an early exact-byte snapshot preflight with an immediate return only for snapshot inconsistency, while preserving all later history and evidence checks for matching staged content.

finalReview.evidence: Two independent scoped reviews of the staged candidate reported P0=0, P1=0, and P2=0. They confirmed that only untrustworthy current snapshots return before history, while matching staged content still executes every existing history, checkpoint, authority, digest, and evidence gate. Three focused tests passed. A real unstaged-record mismatch returned in about 6.7 seconds instead of waiting for the roughly four-minute history audit, and the exact staged candidate passed the canonical capability-governance validator.
